title: Mirror Metallurgy
description: Metals that must never touch anything. Unlocks the Mirror Matter Foundry, anti-metals and the Mirror Alloy.

puzzle.goal: An anti-metal must be held without touching anything, so every antinucleus and positron in it is steered by electromagnetic fields alone. Write the relativistic wave equation for a spin-½ particle of charge q and mass m coupled to the four-potential A_μ, with the coupling entering through the derivative.
puzzle.name: Dirac equation with minimal coupling
puzzle.form: i * ħ * γ ^ μ * ( ∂ _ μ + i * q / ħ * A _ μ ) * ψ - m * c * ψ
puzzle.ask: In a uniform magnetic field its low-energy solutions are Landau levels spaced by ħqB/m: the particle circles at f = qB/(2πm). Find f in MHz for an antiproton in the trap below.

vars.\u2202: partial derivative along a spacetime direction

puzzle.method: Start from the free spinor equation, then replace every derivative by a gauge-covariant derivative that adds the charge times the potential.
